parameters.query: SELECT current_database() AS database, to_regclass('aimfin.jobs') IS NOT NULL AND to_regclass('aimfin.operation_attempts') IS NOT NULL AS schema_ready, NOT rolsuper AND NOT rolbypassrls AS restricted_role FROM pg_roles WHERE rolname=current_user

parameters.jsCode: if (!$json.schema_ready || !$json.restricted_role) throw new Error('AimFin database migration or restricted credential is missing'); return $input.all();

parameters.content:
## ORCHESTRATION
Database readiness precedes intake classification and branch ticks.

## ASYNC BRANCH TICKS
Children launch without waiting. Independent branch clocks provide recovery; PostgreSQL caps and leases bound work.

## CLAIM + GUARD
One leased operation per tick. Idle queues stop safely.

## RECOVERY
The core decides retries; unknown sends are held.

## CLAIM + GUARD
Lease one durable operation. An idle queue ends this tick safely.

## SHEETS OPERATIONS
Metadata check / native RAW read / native fixed-range write.

## TRANSPORT RECOVERY
Unknown outcomes return to the core for controlled reconciliation.
